## Question

Przeworski, Alvarez, Cheibub & Limongi (2000) found that no democracy above
a certain income level (Argentina's 1975 level, roughly $6,000 in their
1985 PPP dollars) had ever collapsed. If that still holds, then for rich
countries democracy is a one-way door.

This notebook asks the same question with V-Dem:

1. Code democracy on the **electoral** definition only: V-Dem Regimes of the
   World (`v2x_regime`) ≥ 2, i.e. electoral or liberal democracy. Rights
   indices are not used to *define* democracy.
2. Call a **breakdown** any year a country goes from democracy (year *t*) to
   autocracy (year *t + 1*).
3. Call a democracy **durable** if it has been continuously democratic for at
   least `durable_years` years.
4. Find the richest breakdown ever, overall and for durable democracies, and
   the breakdown rate by income band.

Units: V-Dem's `e_gdppc` comes from Fariss et al.'s latent-GDP estimates and
is not in Przeworski's 1985 dollars, so the threshold here is found **from
the data** (the richest breakdown observed), not by converting $6,000.

> **Status:** first draft, not yet rendered against the full database.
> Check the `e_gdppc` units line in the output before reading the numbers.

## Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(DBI)
library(duckdb)
library(ggplot2)
source("../../../pipelines/_helpers.R")

# Tunable definitions — change these to stress-test the result.
demo_threshold <- 2   # v2x_regime >= 2: electoral or liberal democracy
durable_years  <- 20  # continuous democratic years before a breakdown "counts" as durable
start_year     <- 1900

con <- dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb(),
                 dbdir = "../../../data/panel.duckdb", read_only = TRUE)
```

## Pull regime type and income

```{r}
#| label: pull
vd <- dbGetQuery(con, sprintf("
  SELECT country_text_id AS iso3c,
         country_name,
         year,
         v2x_regime,
         v2x_polyarchy,
         e_gdppc
  FROM vdem
  WHERE year >= %d AND v2x_regime IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY iso3c, year
", start_year))

srs_table(data.frame(
  rows      = nrow(vd),
  countries = length(unique(vd$iso3c)),
  first     = min(vd$year),
  last      = max(vd$year),
  gdppc_non_missing = sum(!is.na(vd$e_gdppc))
), big_mark = TRUE)

# Sanity check on units: print a few known values so the reader can see the scale.
srs_table(subset(vd, iso3c %in% c("USA", "ARG", "IND") & year == 2000,
                 select = c(country_name, year, e_gdppc)))
```

## Code democracy, spells, and breakdowns

```{r}
#| label: spells
vd$democracy <- vd$v2x_regime >= demo_threshold

# Run length of the current democratic spell (0 when not a democracy).
vd <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(vd, vd$iso3c), function(d) {
  d <- d[order(d$year), ]
  spell <- integer(nrow(d))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(d))) {
    contiguous <- i > 1 && d$year[i] == d$year[i - 1] + 1
    spell[i] <- if (!d$democracy[i]) 0L
                else if (contiguous) spell[i - 1] + 1L
                else 1L
  }
  d$spell_years <- spell
  d$next_democracy <- c(d$democracy[-1], NA)
  d$next_year      <- c(d$year[-1], NA)
  d
}))

breakdowns <- subset(vd,
  democracy & !is.na(next_democracy) & !next_democracy & next_year == year + 1)
breakdowns$durable <- breakdowns$spell_years >= durable_years

srs_table(data.frame(
  democratic_country_years = sum(vd$democracy),
  breakdowns               = nrow(breakdowns),
  breakdowns_of_durable    = sum(breakdowns$durable)
), big_mark = TRUE)
```

## Every breakdown, richest first

```{r}
#| label: list
show <- breakdowns[order(-breakdowns$e_gdppc),
                   c("country_name", "year", "spell_years", "e_gdppc", "durable")]
srs_table(head(show, 40), digits = 2)
```

## The ratchet threshold

```{r}
#| label: threshold
richest_any     <- show[which.max(show$e_gdppc), ]
richest_durable <- subset(show, durable)
richest_durable <- richest_durable[which.max(richest_durable$e_gdppc), ]

srs_table(rbind(
  cbind(type = "any democracy",     richest_any),
  cbind(type = "durable democracy", richest_durable)
), digits = 2)

# How many democratic country-years sit above each threshold, and none broke down?
above <- function(th) sum(vd$democracy & !is.na(vd$e_gdppc) & vd$e_gdppc > th)
srs_table(data.frame(
  threshold = c("richest breakdown (any)", "richest breakdown (durable)"),
  value     = c(richest_any$e_gdppc, richest_durable$e_gdppc),
  democratic_country_years_above = c(above(richest_any$e_gdppc),
                                     above(richest_durable$e_gdppc))
), digits = 2, big_mark = TRUE)
```

## Breakdown rate by income band

```{r}
#| label: rate-by-income
demo_years <- subset(vd, democracy & !is.na(e_gdppc) & !is.na(next_democracy))
demo_years$band <- cut(demo_years$e_gdppc,
                       breaks = quantile(demo_years$e_gdppc, probs = seq(0, 1, 0.1)),
                       include.lowest = TRUE, dig.lab = 4)
demo_years$broke <- !demo_years$next_democracy & demo_years$next_year == demo_years$year + 1

rates <- aggregate(broke ~ band, data = demo_years,
                   FUN = function(x) c(n = length(x), breakdowns = sum(x), rate = mean(x)))
rates <- data.frame(band = rates$band, rates$broke)
srs_table(rates, digits = 4)

ggplot(rates, aes(x = band, y = rate)) +
  geom_col(fill = srs_palette$accent) +
  labs(x = "GDP per capita decile (V-Dem e_gdppc)",
       y = "Annual breakdown probability",
       title = "Democratic breakdown risk by income decile",
       caption = sprintf("Democracy = v2x_regime >= %d. Source: V-Dem.", demo_threshold)) +
  srs_theme() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

## Robustness to check next

- `demo_threshold <- 3` (liberal democracy only) vs. 2.
- `durable_years` at 10 / 20 / 40.
- Exclude occupation-driven breakdowns (1940 Western Europe), which are not
  internal reversals.
- Swap the income measure for WDI GDP per capita (post-1960) to see whether
  the threshold survives a different GDP series.

## Save

```{r}
#| label: save
dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
con_w <- dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb(), dbdir = "../../../data/panel.duckdb")
dbWriteTable(con_w, "bc_democratic_breakdowns", breakdowns, overwrite = TRUE)
dbDisconnect(con_w, shutdown = TRUE)
```
